question: Should OpenClaw add HEARTBEAT.md task-level model metadata, keep heartbeat routing whole-turn via plugins, or design a broader scheduled-task routing contract first?
rationale: Automation should not choose the public HEARTBEAT.md syntax or split-versus-batched model-call semantics because the choice affects model routing, auth/provider behavior, and session state.

options.title: Design shared routing contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define one reusable heartbeat or scheduled-task routing contract before accepting HEARTBEAT.md-only syntax.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only metadata
options.body: Implement a narrow HEARTBEAT.md task `model` field with explicit split/group execution semantics, docs, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep routing plugin-owned
options.body: Document whole-turn `before_model_resolve` plugins as the supported routing path and leave multiple due heartbeat tasks un-split for now.

recommendation.title: Design shared routing contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define one reusable heartbeat or scheduled-task routing contract before accepting HEARTBEAT.md-only syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest product-boundary signal is the existing model-routing hook design and prior core-versus-plugin routing decisions.
